name: Fighter Sniper
body:
The sniper is a master of keeping distance to make their shots and using camouflage and hiding to their benefit.

Skills: The sniper gains Stealth as a class skill and two extra skill points per level but loses heavy armor proficiency.

This ability alters armor proficiency.

Spotter (Ex)

At 1st level, the sniper reduces the bonus to the DC of Perception checks due to distance by 1/2 their class level (to a minimum of +0 to the DC).

Additionally, the penalty to ranged attacks from distance is reduced by the same amount, to a minimum of -0.

This ability replaces bravery.

Shot from Above (Ex)

Beginning with 3rd level, when making a ranged attack from a higher altitude than their target, the sniper deals +2 damage. These attacks ignore cover unless there is a ceiling or cover above the target.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 3rd level.

Hidden Sniper (Ex)

Starting at 4th level, the sniper reduces the penalty to Stealth checks to remain hidden while sniping by half their class level.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 4th level.

Expert Archer (Ex)

At 5th level, a sniper gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with bows. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels beyond 5th.

This ability replaces the 5th level weapon training.

Camouflaged Armor (Ex)

At 7th level, a sniper learns techniques to camouflage with their armor. They reduce the armor check penalty to Stealth checks from their armor by 1/4 their level (minimum 0).

Additionally, if they take 10 minutes to apply camouflage to their armor, they gain a bonus on Stealth checks equal to 1/2 their class levels on such checks to avoid being spotted. This does not apply to Stealth checks to avoid being heard. Additionally, the camouflage only applies to one terrain taken from the ranger’s favored terrain. To gain any of the benefits, the sniper must be proficient with the armor.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 7th, 11th, and 15th levels.

Arcing Shot (Ex)

Starting with 9th level, so long as there is 40 feet of vertical clearance between the sniper and their target, they treat their maximum range increments as 15 range increments for projectile weapons and 7 range increments for thrown weapons.

This ability replaces the weapon training gained at 9th level.

Camouflage (Ex)

A sniper of 12th level or higher can use the Stealth skill to hide in the terrain for which they used their camouflaged armor ability, even if the terrain doesn’t grant cover or concealment.

This ability replaces the bonus combat feat gained at 12th level.

Horizon Shot (Ex)

Starting with 13th level, as a standard action, the sniper can make a single ranged attack and ignore all ranged penalties on the attack, though it is still restricted by the attack’s maximum range. This attack can be used in conjunction with Vital Strike and other similar feats or abilities.

This ability replaces the weapon training gained at 13th level.

Volley (Ex)

At 17th level, as a full-round action, a sniper can make a single bow attack at their highest base attack bonus against any number of creatures in a 15-foot radius burst, making separate attack and damage rolls for each creature.

This ability replaces the weapon training gained at 17th level.

Hide in Plain Sight (Ex)

At 19th level, while in the terrain chosen when using the camouflaged armor ability, the sniper can use the Stealth skill even while being observed.

This ability replaces armor mastery.

Weapon Mastery (Ex)

A sniper must choose a type of bow for their weapon mastery class feature.
